answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in sable, queued in vertex, and shale publishes the wait time. A farm of 357 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2097 identities would post 4116 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
